patches.purpose: Accept already-decoded tool-call argument objects in the official DeepSeek V4 encoding.
Preserve complete tool calls and correct finish reasons when completion output is truncated.
Route NVFP4 DS MLA long-context decode to the supported fast kernel path.
Reduce GB10 shared-memory IPC spin time before sleeping to lower idle CPU load and SoC heat.
Backport the conditional MTP hidden-state buffer allocation.
Backport the short-context indexer top-k skip with the graph-capture safety guard.
Backport the dormant dense-prefill indexer scoring skip.
Backport empty C128 compressor launch avoidance.
Advance structured-output grammar across the reasoning boundary.
patches.upstream_reference: vLLM pull request 44993 and Mia issue 24

patches.purpose: Prevent encoder-only execution steps from emitting phantom token zero.
Correct scheduler accounting for bounded partial-prefill concurrency.
Add bounded decode service during mixed prefills plus opt-in scheduler diagnostics.
Keep hybrid SWA common-hit calculation from shrinking valid cache hits.
Keep client stop strings dormant while the model is inside reasoning output.
Load the Stage-C DSpark shared-expert gate and up checkpoint shards into the fused gate_up_proj parameter.
patches.upstream_reference: Mia pull request 127 merged at d1b76251535daef578d8751b04b39c29ad7ecdf9
